summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Digital Game Account Marketplace (LZT Vault) - a frontend-only prototype with mock data. All 24 features tested successfully with minor observations.

passed: Dashboard loads with 28 product cards in responsive grid
Navbar renders with logo, nav links (Marketplace, Verified, Hot Deals), API status indicator, Sign In button
Search input filters accounts by title/rank text
Filter sidebar renders with all filter components (Price Range, Min Level, Rank, Region, Origin, Sort By, Has Skins toggle)
Minimum Level slider filters products correctly
Rank dropdown filter works - selecting a rank filters cards
Region dropdown filter works
Origin dropdown filter works
Sort By dropdown works (newest, price asc, price desc, level desc)
Has Skins toggle filters to only show accounts with 5+ skins
Reset filters button resets all filters to defaults
Product cards display rank, level, skin count, VP, price, region badge, origin badge
Clicking a product card opens the preview modal
Preview modal shows: account title, price, badges, seller info, Buy Now button, View on LZT button
Preview modal shows Security Banner (Safe to Play or Account Flagged)
Preview modal shows Stat Grid (Rank, Level, VP, Radianite)
Preview modal shows Skin Collection in masonry grid with tier colors
Preview modal shows Seller Notes in blockquote
Preview modal can be closed via X button (with force click)
Preview modal can be closed by clicking backdrop
Skeleton loading state shows shimmer cards initially
Empty state shows when no results match filters
Mobile filter toggle button visible on small screens
Results count badge updates when filters change

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
Mock data layer generates 28 accounts with proper caching
Mobile responsive design works well with filter overlay
test_credentials: No credentials needed - frontend-only prototype with mock data
seed_data_creation: Mock data is generated client-side in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.js with 28 Valorant accounts
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a frontend-only prototype. All 24 features from the test plan passed. The app uses mock data generated on page load. Key test selectors: data-testid='dashboard', data-testid='navbar', data-testid='search-input', data-testid='filter-sidebar', data-testid='product-card-{id}', data-testid='preview-modal', data-testid='skeleton-grid', data-testid='empty-state'. Modal close button requires force=True for Playwright clicks.
mocked_api_note: ALL DATA IS MOCKED - fetchLztProducts() in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.js returns 28 mock Valorant accounts. No real API calls are made.
